context: Takeda gives Ren a retirement memento.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Measured hand-off, steady and deliberate. Slight pause before speaking, the weight of the moment held in composure. Voice level, authoritative but never cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft surprise, the question almost unfinished. Breath catches slightly on the opening. Grateful undertone threaded beneath the shock, words coming out smaller than intended.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: We protected this town together — I'm grateful.
lines.style: Phrase it simply, no ceremony. Each word deliberate. A man speaking truth without embellishment. Warmth underneath the formality, the kind earned through shared work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: こちらこそ、大切な、思い出。
lines.en: That's all me — it's a precious memory.
lines.style: Soft, almost modest. The words come out carefully, like he's choosing them to be honest without overstating. Slight tremor of genuine feeling beneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: Keep going — as a teacher, keep going.
lines.style: A benediction more than an order. Quiet conviction on the last phrase. Not pushing, but endorsing. The voice of someone who sees who Ren is becoming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Firm commitment, no hesitation. Shorter than before, the brevity a kind of strength. Voice steady, shoulders metaphorically straightening on the words.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: Take care of yourself — let's meet again.
lines.style: The closing benediction. Slower pace, the goodbye held in the spaces between words. Not sentimental, but deeply kind. A man releasing someone he's come to respect.
